objective.en: Read a short life story and put the main events in order: was born, grew up, moved to, won, died. Say what the person is known for.
objective.fr: Lire une courte biographie, remettre les événements dans l’ordre (naître, grandir, déménager, gagner, mourir) et dire pourquoi la personne est connue.
objective.de: Eine kurze Biografie lesen, die wichtigsten Ereignisse ordnen (geboren, aufgewachsen, umgezogen, gewonnen, gestorben) und sagen, wofür die Person bekannt ist.

documents.title: Marie Curie
paragraphs: Marie Curie was born in Warsaw, Poland, in 1867. She grew up in a family of teachers and she loved science as a child.
In 1891 she moved to Paris to study at university. There she met a scientist called Pierre Curie, and they got married in 1895.

Marie and Pierre worked together and found two new elements. In 1903 she won the Nobel Prize in Physics. In 1911 she won a second Nobel Prize, this time in Chemistry. She was the first person to win two.
Marie Curie is known for her work on radioactivity. She died in France in 1934. Today many schools and hospitals have her name.

documents.title: Roald Dahl
paragraphs: Roald Dahl was born in Cardiff, Wales, in 1916. As a boy, he loved sweets and stories. In 1934 he moved to Africa for his job.
Later he became a pilot. After the war he started to write books for children. He is known for Charlie and the Chocolate Factory and Matilda. He died in 1990.
